incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 — Cross-region routing anomalies detected between eu-west and us-east. High error rate + elevated tail latency for requests routed to us-east from EU. Alert threshold crossed at 2026-03-15T01:12:31Z. Notifying on-call.

olivia (oncall): I'm on it, paging eng-sre and network. Can someone confirm scope?

raj (eng-sre): seeing spikes in 5xxs and connection resets from the eu-edge -> us-east pool. Logs show intermittent "route-not-found" and some requests rerouted to cold wallet instances. Investigating routing policy evals.

kevin (eng-runtime): we deployed a routing policy tweak 22m ago to tweak latency steering weights for blue/green. Rolling back that change now to rule id = rp-2026-03-15-01:00.

sophie (eng-network): DNS lookups look normal; however, control-plane is returning mixed region pins for roughly 3% of traces. TTLs still 30s. Pushing a repro run for the policy evaluator.

olivia (oncall): amy, support — any customer reports?

amy (support): getting 4 tickets flagged from EU customers complaining about 502s and increased latency over the last 20 minutes. Marking impacted customers for comms.

raj (eng-sre): I see the routing engine logs:
```
[2026-03-15T01:09:12Z] eval_policy(rp-2026-03-15-01:00) -> decision: steer(us-east)
[2026-03-15T01:09:12Z] pin_lookup(user:12345) -> region: eu-west (expected)
[2026-03-15T01:09:12Z] proxy: forwarded to us-east pool-7 (unexpected)
```
Looks like the policy evaluator returned an incorrect fallback code path when latency data was missing. Possibly a nil-check bug in the evaluator for short-lived metrics.

kevin (eng-runtime): confirming — runtime telemetry shows missing latency series for some edge nodes due to a metrics ingestion lag we had earlier today. The evaluator treats missing series as +infinity latency, which caused an oversteer to us-east. I'll patch but we should mitigate first.

sophie (eng-network): mitigation idea: disable latency-based steering globally (toggle steering.enabled=false) to force pin-based routing until we patch. That will stop aggressive cross-region moves.

olivia (oncall): do it. Execute toggle and verify. Raj, coordinate the rollback + toggle. Amy please draft a short customer note and escalate to SEs.

raj (eng-sre): Applying rollback + steering toggle now. Command run:
```
# rollback policy
rbctl policies rollback rp-2026-03-15-01:00 --to=rp-2026-03-14-23:58
# disable steering
rbctl config set steering.enabled false --scope=global
```

raj (eng-sre): Applied both. Watching metrics.

kevin (eng-runtime): runtime acknowledges new config, restarting policy-evaluator pods to pick up config: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/policy-evaluator -n inference-prod`.

sophie (eng-network): I see traffic rebalance back to eu-west pools within ~20s. Error rate dropping. Latency tail normalizing.

olivia (oncall): status update? impact numbers?

amy (support): impacted ~0.8% of requests during the spike window. 7 customers filed tickets; triage shows 2 were revenue-sensitive. No SSO or data-loss.

raj (eng-sre): Current state: steering disabled, rp rolled back, policy-evaluator restarted. Error rate back to baseline. I'll keep monitors in watch for 30m.

kevin (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: policy evaluator treats missing latency metrics as infinite, causing fallback to default region with higher capacity (us-east). Fix will add explicit missing-data handling and unit tests. I'll open a PR and target hotfix branch.

sophie (eng-network): follow-up: we should add a guard in control-plane to prevent cross-region steering > 1% of traffic within a 1-minute window unless explicitly allowed. Feature ticket created: RNW-1423.

olivia (oncall): handing incident to raj for postmortem/workflow. I'm going off-call in 18m; raj, please take lead on RCA and comms. @amy, publish interim status to affected customers: short blurb + that we're investigating and mitigation applied.

amy (support): drafting now: "We observed intermittent 5xxs/latency for EU traffic routed to us-east. We've reverted a routing change and disabled latency-steering; traffic has rebalanced. We'll follow up with a full postmortem." Will send to affected list in 10m.

raj (eng-sre): taking over ops. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-2239991111. Will capture timeline and attach logs.

kevin (eng-runtime): PR created for evaluator guard: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4876 (adds nil-check + default to last-known latency). Assigning to sophie for review.

sophie (eng-network): reviewed and left comments. Add e2e test simulating missing metrics.

olivia (oncall): thanks all. I'll be available for 15min then off. Marking this as mitigated for paging; transition to post-incident follow-up. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status change: PAGED -> MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T01:15:51Z. Follow-up: RCA assigned to raj, action items assigned in INC-2026-2239991111.
